items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: And this boy Sam could sing. Yeah he could sing. And they'd come in here and stay in here for the day, just play and sing.

ctx.x: Well I know all them fellas, Rabbit and this boy Walter down there, he'd run that place down there, I'm telling you not. He's a bartender there now. Now I don't know if Noon stopped playing, is he playing yet? Yeah he's playing. He's playing yet? He plays yet? Huh? But no, there was a kick, so them guys used to come around and from one place to another him and Sam and his boy was like, I don't know if he was playing. He's playing. He's playing. He's playing. He's playing. He's playing yet? He plays yet? Yeah,…
Serenading has dropped off. Well they all bum at Buster's you know. Oh yeah. At Orleans and Burgundy.
